data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Paystack payments via WebView using public keys.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to accept payments through Paystack via an inline WebView or browser tab. Supports card, mobile money, bank transfers, USSD, and split payments using only a public key.
use_when: You need to integrate Paystack payments into your Flutter application.
You want client-side payment flows using only the public key.
avoid_when: You do not use Paystack as your payment gateway.
You want client-side transaction verification without a backend.
strengths: Supports multiple payment channels including mobile money and card.
Eliminates the security risk of embedding secret keys in client code.
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.
weaknesses: Requires a separate backend server to verify transactions securely.
Relies on WebView implementation for mobile platforms.
data.setup_notes: Android requires updating the minSdkVersion to at least 19 in build.gradle. No extra iOS configuration required.

alternatives.name: flutter_stripe
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Stripe instead of Paystack for payment processing.

alternatives.name: in_app_purchase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need native Apple App Store and Google Play Store billing instead of web payment gateways.
